name: TabPulse — Tab Recovery for WooCommerce
author: pulseware

sections.description:
TabPulse catches customers the moment they switch away from your cart or checkout page — by animating the browser tab title with custom messages.

No intrusive pop-ups. No email sequences. Just a subtle, effective nudge right in the tab bar.

Free features (this plugin)

  • ✅ Unlimited custom tab messages
  • ✅ {cart_total} placeholder — show the customer their own cart value (e.g. “You left $47.50 behind!”)
  • ✅ Configurable rotation speed (1–10 seconds)
  • ✅ Returns counter — see how many customers came back to your tab this week
  • ✅ Works on cart and checkout pages only — zero footprint everywhere else
  • ✅ No jQuery. No external requests. Vanilla JS.
  • ✅ Multisite compatible

TabPulse Pro (separate plugin at tabpulse.net)

TabPulse Pro adds revenue-focused features on top of the free version:

  • 🔴 Favicon badge — a red notification dot on your store’s favicon
  • 💸 Auto-coupons — automatically apply a discount the moment a customer returns to the tab
  • 📊 Revenue analytics — see exactly how much revenue TabPulse recovered
  • 🧪 A/B message testing — find out which messages convert best
  • 🏷️ White label — remove TabPulse branding (Agency plan)
  • 🔗 Webhooks — connect to Mailchimp, Klaviyo, and other tools (Agency plan)

Get TabPulse Pro →

14-day free trial, no credit card required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tabpulse-tab-recovery-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Go to Settings → TabPulse to configure your messages.
sections.faq:
Does this work without WooCommerce?

No. TabPulse is designed specifically for WooCommerce cart and checkout pages.

Will this slow down my store?

No. The JS file is loaded only on cart and checkout pages, weighs under 3 KB, and has zero external dependencies.

Can I use {cart_total} in my messages?

Yes. Add {cart_total} anywhere in a message and TabPulse will replace it with the customer’s actual cart value (e.g. $47.50).

Where does the return counter data come from?

Every time a customer returns to your cart or checkout tab (after switching away), TabPulse records that event. The counter in your admin panel shows how many returns were detected this week and this month.

How is TabPulse Pro different?

The free version animates the tab and counts returns. Pro tells you how much revenue those returns generated, applies automatic discount coupons to close the sale, and lets you A/B test your messages. See tabpulse.net for details.
